QUESTION:
What is the recommended dose of Amoxicillin for pediatric patients?

RESPONSE:
The recommended dose of amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium for oral suspension (600 mg/42.9 mg per 5 mL) for pediatric patients aged 3 months to 12 years weighing ≤40 kg is 90 mg/kg/day divided every 12 hours, administered for 10 days. This dose is based on the amoxicillin component and provides 6.4 mg/kg/day of the clavulanic acid component. The medication should be taken at the start of a meal to minimize gastrointestinal intolerance and enhance clavulanate potassium absorption. A dosage table is provided in the label showing specific volumes for different body weights (ranging from 3 mL twice daily for an 8 kg patient to 15 mL twice daily for a 40 kg patient). For pediatric patients weighing >40 kg, experience with this specific formulation is not available.
